text:
QUOTE: "the deny list is the only one that can stop a call after the approval step" and "This is the only place the deny list is consulted." and "The deny check in step 4 is then the only real stop."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says ServerManager::execute consults the deny list and, as the "only real stop", it is the sole blocking check there. Step 3's "Permission denied" occurs only when no callback is set, so the answer doesn't say deny is the single blocker overall. But it does say the allow list never blocks and the deny check is the only real stop.
